opening.notice: First ground contact. No pin, no target, no score. Revise a piece and fire the same shot.

beforeSuccess.notice: No pin or score. Move a piece, or change origin, aim, and power inside the rail stops. Fire when the shot is the one you want.

success.notice: Line ended: settled. No pin, no target, no score.

galleryText:
Bell Loft

A stone loft stands in the clearing. Three of its walls are bells; the fourth stands aside. Down here, the ground ends every line it touches. The loft floor is not the ground. The shot can change, and so can that fourth wall and the wooden stair.
